definition: Preserve the current retained qualifying result.
Forfeit the current retained result and enter the probabilistic rerun branch.
Withdrawal occurs but no qualifying rerun is completed before the supported session cutoff.
allowed_use: Explicit downside probability. Must not silently be converted to zero speed.

definition: Completed rerun speed exceeds current retained speed.
Completed rerun improves by at least a user- or scenario-specified mph threshold.
If an external target speed T is known, required gain = T - current retained speed.
allowed_use: May be applied only when target speed is externally supplied or defensibly reconstructed.
